subtopics.title: Defining Application Requirements
subtopics.summary: Identifying the specific functional and non-functional needs of an application, such as latency, accuracy, cost, and privacy, to establish the criteria for model selection.

subtopics.title: Comparing Model Capabilities
subtopics.summary: Evaluating different foundation models based on their architecture, parameter size, modality support, and general performance characteristics to match them with application needs.

subtopics.title: Evaluating Model Performance
subtopics.summary: Using benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and comparative testing to determine how well a specific model performs on tasks relevant to the target application.

subtopics.title: Analyzing Cost and Deployment Trade-offs
subtopics.summary: Assessing the financial and infrastructure implications of using proprietary APIs versus self-hosted open-weight models, including inference costs and scaling requirements.
